sourceFacts.claim: M_BPartner is the iDempiere record for a business partner (customer, supplier or vendor); the class carries the party identity and partner role fields.
C_BPartner_Location links a BPartner to a location and carries IsBillTo / IsShipTo role flags, expressing the party-to-location relation.
MBPartner.getTemplate constructs a reset business-partner template (an operation on the party object).
MBPartnerLocation.get(ctx, C_BPartner_Location_ID) returns the partner location record (input: id, output: record).
IsActive is a Boolean column on C_BPartner (the party active state).
Within the captured MBPartner save/template methods, no event publish/subscribe or change-notification mechanism is declared for party changes.
MBPartner.getTemplate throws IllegalArgumentException when Client_ID=0 (a precondition on the client context).
MBPartner.getLocations queries C_BPartner_Location WHERE IsActive='Y' (only active locations are exposed, an invariant).
MBPartner wraps a DB read in try/catch and logs the failure at SEVERE (error handling for party reads).
MBPartnerLocation reads back the locations for a partner (readback operation).
No RMI / web-service / REST endpoint exposing party operations is declared in the captured C_BPartner interface.
No explicit conflict- or ambiguity-resolution marker (duplicate/merge) is declared for party identity in the captured C_BPartner columns.
MProduct is the iDempiere record for a product/item (the offering); the class carries Name, ProductType and role flags (IsSold/IsPurchased/IsStocked).
M_Product.Category_ID links a product to M_Product_Category (the product-to-category relation).
MProduct.beforeSave validates and prepares the product record before persisting (an operation on the product object).
MProduct.get(ctx, M_Product_ID) returns the product record (input: id, output: record).
Discontinued is a Boolean (with DiscontinuedAt date) on M_Product (the product lifecycle state).
Within the captured MProduct get methods, no event publish/subscribe or change-notification mechanism is declared for product changes.
MProduct.beforeSave enforces product preconditions before persisting the record.
MProduct.beforeDelete throws when a resource product has S_Resource_ID<>0 (a delete invariant).
MProduct throws AdempiereException on invariant violation (error reporting for product).
MProduct reads back the product record from the cache/DB (readback).
No RMI / web-service / REST endpoint exposing product operations is declared in the captured M_Product interface.
No explicit conflict- or ambiguity-resolution marker (duplicate/merge) is declared for product identity in the captured M_Product columns.
MOrder is the iDempiere record for a sales order; the class carries the order identity, doc type and header fields.
C_Order.C_BPartner_ID links the order header to the business partner (header-to-party relation).
MOrder performs a document action on the sales order (an operation).
MOrderLine documents the order-line input/output fields (product, quantity, price, priceActual, tax) in its usage contract.
DocStatus is a column on C_Order (the order document status).
Within the captured MOrder reserveStock/explodeBOM methods, no event publish/subscribe or change-notification mechanism is declared for order changes.
MOrder validates address/billing preconditions before processing (preconditions).
MOrder throws IllegalStateException when order/line creation fails (creation invariants).
MOrder throws DBException/AdempiereException on order errors (error reporting).
MOrder defines a matching GROUP BY SQL template used to read back open order quantities.
No RMI / web-service / REST endpoint exposing sales operations is declared in the captured MOrderLine.
MOrder logs a WarehouseOrgConflict warning when the warehouse and order document belong to different organizations (a conflict marker).
